d: Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted a historic trilateral at the 2026 Apec Summit in Shenzhen with US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin. On the agenda were the wars in Iran and Ukraine. The three world leaders also discussed Taiwan. Meanwhile, Trump urged China to join a Nuclear Arms Control Treaty. Meanwhile, Putin spoke to Trump and Xi about the war in Ukraine.
